title: NexKeyRuntime activation certificate
description: Envelope produced by the sdkGateway when activating or syncing a license. `payload` and `signature` are base64url; `payload`, once decoded, is the canonical JSON described by the `payload` definition below, and `signature` is the Ed25519 signature of those exact decoded bytes, verified against the public key in the ProductData keyring identified by `keyId`.

keyId.description: Identifies which key in the ProductData keyring signed this payload.

payload.description: Base64url-encoded canonical JSON matching the `payload` definition.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the decoded payload bytes.

payload.description: Decoded, verified payload — mirrors nexkeyruntime::licensing::Claims (MCSDK/src/licensing/Certificate/Claims.h) field-for-field.

tenantId.description: Slug, matched against the value the plugin passes to set_tenant_id.

activationId.description: Opaque; ties to the local receipt file name.

machineBinding.description: Matched byte-exact against the local machine binding value.

edition.description: Opaque label; the SDK never interprets it.

entitlement.description: Slug, matched against the value the plugin passes to set_variant.
